name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Simulate time evolution of the 3-site Heisenb
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Simulate time evolution of the 3-site Heisenberg XXZ chain (Jx=Jy=1, Jz=0.73, open boundary) for time t=1.84 in Qiskit using first-order Trotterization with 60 steps. Start from the Neel state and compare <Z_0>(t) against exact evolution with scipy.linalg.expm. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
